item.title: Denmark to get custody of Greenland at the weekends
item.description: In an attempt to calm the world order, the United States has announced that it will let Denmark have full visitation rights at the weekend, as long as it returns Greenland to the US while it is still light. 'No keeping Greenland out after dark,' insisted a US spokesman, noting that Greenland is dark essentially October to March.
